name: rksp-kursach-rag-chatbot
description: Client-server RAG chatbot for internal knowledge base support

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.rag:build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192 npm run ingest --workspace @rksp/backend -- ../../data/raw/kaggle ../../data/processed/ingestion-manifest.json && npm run index --workspace @rksp/backend -- ../../data/processed/ingestion-manifest.json ../../data/processed/vector-index.json
